crates.name: lib
crates.summary: Go package exports for BalET load-balancer types, selection constants, constructors, and request logging.

items.name: Server
items.summary: Backend endpoint type. Its ip and weight fields are unexported, so external Go packages cannot construct or configure Server values.
items.example: // Server fields are package-private in the current source.

items.name: Request
items.summary: Request data type. Its method, URL, and body fields are unexported, limiting external construction.
items.example: // Request fields are package-private in the current source.

items.name: Algo
items.summary: Selector type for the package’s round-robin, least-connections, and weighted-connections strategies.

items.name: WeightedConnections
items.summary: Select weighted connections using each server’s configured weight.

items.name: LogManager
items.signature: type LogManager struct { /* internal buffer and flush state */
items.summary: Thread-safe request/response logger. Construct it with NewLogManager and use Log or LazyLog.

items.name: NewLogManager
items.signature: func NewLogManager(fpath string, flsh uint64, mx_l uint64) LogManager
items.summary: Create a log manager. flsh controls the lazy flush interval; mx_l sets the buffer-size limit.

items.name: Log
items.summary: Append a request and response pair to the configured log file immediately.

items.name: LazyLog
items.summary: Buffer a request/response log entry and flush according to the configured thresholds.

items.name: BalEt
items.signature: type BalEt struct { /* internal queue, servers, and scheduler state */
items.summary: Value returned by NewBalET. Its fields and operational methods are unexported in the current source, so consumers cannot configure backends or submit requests through the package API.

items.name: NewBalET
items.signature: func NewBalET(timeout uint64, buff_l uint64, srvr_root_pfx string) BalEt
items.summary: Create the load-balancer value with a timeout, buffered request capacity, and backend URL prefix. The current package does not export its server-registration or request-dispatch methods.

items.name: IF
items.signature: func IF[T any](cond bool, if_true T, if_false T) T
items.summary: Return if_true when cond is true; otherwise return if_false.
